#include <iostream>
#include <string>

int main() {
    int n;
    std::cin >> n;
    std::cin.ignore(); // ignore newline after n
    std::string in;
    std::getline(std::cin, in);

    bool bracket = false, brackword = false;
    int prevWord = 0, inBrackets = 0, word = 0;

    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        char c = in[i];

        if (c == '(') {
            if (word > prevWord)
                prevWord = word;
            word = 0;
            bracket = true;
        } else if (c == ')') {
            bracket = false;
            if (brackword)
                inBrackets++;
            brackword = false;
        } else if (c == '_') {
            if (word > prevWord)
                prevWord = word;
            word = 0;
            if (brackword) {
                inBrackets++;
                brackword = false;
            }
        } else {
            if (bracket)
                brackword = true;
            else
                word++;
        }
    }

    if (word > prevWord)
        prevWord = word;

    std::cout << prevWord << " " << inBrackets << std::endl;

    return 0;
}
</translated_code>
